title: 23-BCV-003 — Insulation below a heated floor

facts.text: The variance applies to Part 9 buildings with a heated floor in contact with the ground, above or below the frost line.
The stated alternative is minimum RSI 1.32 (R-7.5) insulation below the heated floor.
The source cites Sentence 9.36.2.8.(1), whose table values for heated floors are RSI 2.32 or 2.84 depending on heating-degree-day zone and ventilation system.
facts.locator: PDF pp.1–2, Code References and Tables 9.36.2.8.-A/B

facts.text: The source attributes function F92 and objective OE1.1 to limiting uncontrolled thermal transfer and excessive energy use.
